input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个男人，他的名字是神农。他看到了有很多人不知道哪个植物好吃，也不知道什么植物对你的身体有好处。这个问题神农觉得很糟糕，所以神农去了吃每种植物。他吃了一种植物以后，就写了这个植物对你有没有好处。有的时候，神农吃了很好吃的植物。有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After describing that people do not know which plants are safe, add a concrete consequence to make the problem clearer: “很多人因为吃了有毒的植物，常常生病。”
2. At the point where he decides to try plants, include his determination: “神农想：我一定要找出哪些植物可以吃。”
3. When he talks with his friends, add a short line of speech showing what he records: “这种植物对身体有好处，我要记下来。”

ideas.reason: It gives a concrete consequence that fits why Shennong wants to test the plants.
It adds a fitting thought and clearly shows Shennong’s purpose.
The learner already says that Shennong writes down whether each plant is good for the body.
